item.description:
- Prevent sideways movement in Browser and Grid, including short folders and layout changes.
- Open a media folder by dropping it onto Louppe's Dock icon or directly into the review window. Folder changes save existing decisions first and preserve the chosen window size. - Customize single-key review shortcuts in Settings, using keyboard characters or physical key positions for Dvorak and other layouts. Assign several keys per action, narrow each key by view or media, and reuse keys only where their contexts do not overlap. A visual keyboard helps find assigned actions, and the searchable editor supports adding, removing and resetting keys. New setups default to physical positions; saved choices are retained. Menu hints align in the native shortcut column and update with changed bindings. Command and Shift keyboard layers reveal modified shortcuts; Export, Command Palette and Rescan support custom Command aliases. Related keys appear together in the editor. Menus, the Command Palette and Help show current keys; standard Mac commands and modified navigation retain their familiar behavior. - Show Fuji film simulation in Info and filter by simulation, including monochrome and ACROS variants. - Keep RAW display and decoder preferences in Settings, with a simpler Gallery zoom bar for Fit and magnification. - Show a small loading indicator beside photo zoom while the full preview is still replacing a thumbnail. Cached previews stay ready without a loading flash; navigation cannot publish the previous photo's loading state. - Simplify Rename Files with draggable filename parts and dates matching the Mac’s preferred format. Keep keyboard/VoiceOver reordering and the exact preview, conflict checks, and confirmation. Help explains how to rename keepers. - Documented JPEG XL support and added real JPEG XL, AVIF, and WebP regression fixtures for scanning, thumbnails, Gallery previews, and actual-size tiles.
Thanks to Henri and Aymeric, whose reviews and feature requests helped shape the last two updates. Send feedback and ideas to [a@alex-markin.com](mailto:a@alex-markin.com).
